Optimal.Notes: Native 1280x800 at high quality settings is well within the Deck's capability given DREDGE's very low PC requirements; 7 W TDP gives clean 60 fps with comfortable battery life.

profiles.Summary: DREDGE is a lightweight indie fishing/adventure game with very modest PC requirements, making it an excellent fit for the Steam Deck — it should run at a locked 60 fps with minimal effort. The game is Steam Deck Verified and runs natively well under Proton with full controller support out of the box.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the game's very modest PC requirements (minimum GPU is a GeForce 8800 GT, far below the Deck's RDNA 2) and the Steam Deck Verified status. On your first run, confirm the frame counter stays at 60 in busy harbour areas and at night — if it does, the Optimal profile is all you need.

MaxBattery.Notes: Extremely conservative settings for maximum session length; the game is undemanding enough that even 4 W TDP holds 30 fps easily. Bump to Optimal if the FSR upscale looks too soft.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Maximum quality at full Deck resolution; the game's minimum spec is far below Deck hardware so a rock-solid 60 fps is easily achievable even at max settings. Higher TDP headroom prevents any micro-stutter during busy scenes.

Optimal.Notes: High quality settings at native resolution hold a rock-solid 60 fps with plenty of GPU headroom to spare. This is the recommended daily-driver profile for DREDGE on the Deck OLED.

profiles.Summary: DREDGE is a lightweight indie fishing adventure with very modest PC requirements, and the Steam Deck handles it effortlessly — expect smooth 60+ fps at native resolution with minimal power draw. It is Steam Deck Verified with full controller support and runs natively well under Proton.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the very modest PC minimum requirements (circa GTX 8800 class) and the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU, which vastly exceeds them. On first run, confirm the frame rate is stable in harbour areas and at night with fog effects — these are the most likely stress points.

MaxBattery.Notes: At 4 W TDP the game runs comfortably at a locked 30 fps; the GPU clock floor of 400 MHz is more than enough for this lightweight title. Ideal for long sessions away from a charger.

MaxPerformance.Notes: The game's minimal GPU demands allow the Deck OLED to push 90 Hz at max settings; the higher TDP and GPU clock ensure the frame time stays smooth at the elevated refresh rate. Battery life drops significantly at this setting.
